pages.title: Defense and response
pages.text: Projectile-tagged direct hits on the main body are rejected; sleep and teleportation protect that body too. Separate parts have their own hit route, so this

pages.title: Defense and response
pages.text: does not establish immunity for every part. Change your aim and attack an exposed part after it moves.

pages.title: Ordinary combat
pages.text: This profile does not use hosted preparation. Fight it normally rather than looking for Start. Defeating this enemy contributes to world-tier progression.

pages.title: Loot and use
pages.text: Native loot for this encounter includes: Large Shulker Shell, shulker shell. Inspect the obtained item’s uses in JEI to choose your next equipment. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory.
